flaws.description: Swapped both ax.plot() line series for ax.scatter(), removing the incompatible linewidth= and linestyle= keywords (line-only styling) so the rose chart now shows scattered points instead of connected lines.
Changed the Latin America (Developing) renewable energy share value in the inline data list from 55.6 to 25.0, so the plotted point no longer matches the true value shown in the table.
